slug: 2026-07-06 Powertel, Paratus Zimbabwe switch on new digital highway

facts.fact: Powertel and Paratus Zimbabwe say the first phase of their cross-border fibre project, the Plumtree-Bulawayo section into Zimbabwe, is live and carrying traffic at 800Gbps initial equipped capacity; the article is dated 2026-07-06 and gives no earlier date for the switch-on.

The article says the corridor is the first milestone of a public-private partnership agreement signed in June 2025 between Powertel and Paratus Zimbabwe to build long-distance fibre linking Zimbabwe to Botswana, Zambia and South Africa.

systems.owner: Powertel Communications (ZESA subsidiary) with Paratus Zimbabwe under an IRU
